title: Your first program
hints: Printing lives in the `fmt` package: add `import "fmt"` below the package clause.
`fmt.Println` prints its arguments separated by spaces and ends with a newline: `fmt.Println("x", 1)` prints `x 1`.

`fmt.Println(a, "+", b, "=", a+b)` prints `2 + 3 = 5`. `fmt.Printf("%d + %d = %d
", a, b, a+b)` works too.
